title: Queenz Eye, Nice to meet you. Their 1st single Album shows their story & their’s charm
description:
"실력으로 하나된 여왕이 탄생했습니다!"
멤버 전원이 안무를 창작한 퍼포먼스 맛집 퀸즈아이가
첫번째 싱글 앨범 [Queenz Table]을 들고 super kpop을 찾아 왔다.
신곡에 대해 이야기하고 라이브도 들어 보는 시간을 갖는다.
또한 이미지 게임을 통해 멤버들의 인간적인 매력을 들여다보는 기회도 마련했다.

"A queen who is united with their skills has been born!"
Queenz Eye, a good performance where all the members created choreography
They came to visit super kpop with their first single album [Queenz Table].
We have time to talk about the new song and listen to it live.
It also provided an opportunity to look into the members' human charms through image games.
